findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 0.0, but the source investment schedule reports Investments Total at -54.4% of NAV.

rationale: Class 3 anchor check: the raw schedule total in table 10 row 8 shows Investments Total fair value of 646,250 and -54.4% of NAV, while the flagged oracle metric reports pct_sum=0.0%. The related controlled-affiliate roll-forward confirms the 646,250 fair value but provides no contrary percentage anchor. The source therefore grounds an aggregate percentage extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
